Presealed minimum purpose (collector paraphrase): 자동 prerequisites를 만들 때 GCC -M 대신 -MM을 쓰면 system header를 제외하는 이유와 옵션 상세를 읽는다.

Original context:
With the GNU C compiler, you may wish to use the ‘-MM’ flag instead
of ‘-M’.  This omits prerequisites on system header files.
See Options Controlling the Preprocessor in Using GNU CC, for details.
